verdicts.decision_note: First concrete failure showing character-rendering style drift, especially Kestrel appearing too clean, simple, and polished.
The client changes the rendered character-style target to a raw graffiti aesthetic and rejects clean, simple, polished treatment; no obsolete known key requires removal.
The client adds concrete visual acceptance traits for character rendering: darker, rougher, more sketch-like, and showing more attitude; no prior key is made obsolete.
